Abdullah Mukter Jewel

Student of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE), Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), Bangladesh

PlanCraft 3D is a free home planning tool made by Abdullah Mukter Jewel, studying Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE) at CUET, Bangladesh. It started as a personal project to plan a family house and grew into a full 2D and 3D planner with a cost estimator that uses local material prices.

Get in touch

Questions, feedback, bug reports and partnership requests are welcome. Please contact us through the project page on GitHub (open an issue).

When you report a problem, tell us your device, browser and what you were doing. We read every message and usually reply within a few days.

Good to know

  • The planner and guides are free to use, and your drawings stay on your own device.
  • Material prices in the cost estimate are approximate and editable, so send corrections if a price in your district looks far off.
  • Suggestions for new features, guides and local material rates are especially welcome.

We cannot give structural design advice or approve building plans. Please consult a licensed engineer or architect for that.
